pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Tabs pattern (automatic and manual activation), with native buttons as tabs.

aria.value: true on the selected tab, false otherwise
0 when the panel contains no focusable element
Native disabled for disabled tabs (skipped by arrow keys)

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the selected tab (single tab stop).
Moves focus into the active panel (or its first focusable element).
Next / previous enabled tab, wrapping; mirrored in RTL. Automatic mode also selects it.
Next / previous enabled tab, wrapping. Automatic mode also selects it.
First / last enabled tab. Automatic mode also selects it.

focus: One tab stop on the selected tab. In manual mode focus can move without selecting; when focus leaves the tablist, the tab stop returns to the selected tab. Re-rendering never moves or blurs the focused tab.
notes: Selection is conveyed by aria-selected, an indicator bar, and heavier weight (not color alone).
Inactive panels use the hidden attribute, so they are removed from the accessibility tree.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
